Among respondents, 35.3% reported sleeping <7 hours on average during a 24-hour period
35.3% reported <7 hours of sleep in a typical 24-hour period
Adults aged ≥65 years were significantly less likely to report sleeping <7 hours (24.5%) than persons in all other age categories
Age-standardized (to the projected U.S. 2000 population) prevalence estimates were calculated by state and by selected characteristics
